summary: Verified the Community Resource Ecosystem refactor: new public LandingPage, public endpoints /api/activity/live + /api/leaderboard/public, refactored DashboardPage with Daily Activity Tracker hero, and POPIA/transparency compliance. 8/9 backend tests pass; landing page renders all required sections/testids; dashboard renders all required testids; POPIA nudge appears on /auth signup tab; final-cta/hero-cta navigate to /auth; /messages still hides BottomNav.

minor.issue: Seed-padding logic does not respect `limit` strictly. When real leaders count < 5 AND limit < 5, endpoint returns limit+1 rows (got 4 for limit=3). Cause: in public_leaderboard, the seed loop appends before the `>= limit` break check. Fix: change the loop body to `if len(out) >= limit: break` BEFORE appending. Non-blocking for the UI (UI requests limit=10 on landing, limit=5 on dashboard and got exactly 5/10 real seeds respectively).

ui_bugs.issue: Individual leader rows inside data-testid='dashboard-leaderboard' lack `data-testid^='leader-'` attributes (found 0 rows by that selector, although 5 rows ARE visually rendered). Review spec for landing specifies leader-<rank> selectors and that convention was not extended to the dashboard mini-leaderboard. Cosmetic / testability issue only.

action_items: (LOW) Fix /api/leaderboard/public seed-padding to strictly respect `limit` (move `>= limit` check before append). Not blocking since all UI callers use limit >=5.
(LOW) Add data-testid='leader-{rank}' to leader rows inside DashboardPage's dashboard-leaderboard for consistency with the landing-page leaderboard.
critical_code_review_comments: LandingPage.js is ~365 lines — acceptable but trending towards the 700-line soft limit; consider extracting HeroSection, NetworkScoreSection, etc. when it grows.
server.py is 3918 lines — already far past the 700-line guideline; should be split into routers (auth, activity, leaderboard, score, premium, stokvel, etc.) to improve maintainability.
Public endpoints /activity/live and /leaderboard/public correctly exclude MongoDB `_id` and do not require auth — good.
LiveActivityFeed polls every 10s using setInterval + axiosInstance; OK. Consider pausing when tab is hidden (document.visibilityState) to reduce backend load.
On /dashboard /score/summary + /dashboard + /leaderboard/public are fetched in parallel via Promise.all — good. Error path only shows a toast; no retry UI.

success_rate.backend: 89% (8/9 pytest cases pass; 1 minor limit-handling failure on /leaderboard/public)
success_rate.frontend: ~97% (all landing/dashboard testids present and visible; POPIA nudge correct on signup tab; navigation to /auth and /activity works; /messages hides BottomNav; compliance copy only appears in transparency/disclaimer contexts)

test_credentials: Created dynamic test user via API (POST /api/auth/progressive-signup + /api/auth/complete-profile) email test_landing_<rand>@example.com / Test123!; token injected into localStorage for /dashboard testing.
seed_data_creation: One test user created per run via progressive-signup flow. No cleanup fixture added (these TEST_ users are harmless and match the 'landing_' prefix).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public endpoints /api/activity/live and /api/leaderboard/public work without auth. Landing page at / renders for un-auth users (LandingPage), while OnboardingPage is at /onboarding. /dashboard requires Bearer token; auth-popia-nudge only renders on Sign Up tab, NOT Login tab. Terms checkbox on signup is a custom div that intercepts clicks — prefer API-driven signup for authed-flow tests. Landing compliance: 'returns' appears exactly 3 times in page text, all inside transparency/clarity blocks. Dashboard compliance: 'returns' appears once inside trust-nudge disclaimer.

rca_of_the_issue.leaderboard_limit_bug: In /api/leaderboard/public, the pad-with-seeded loop (server.py ~line 1306) appends a seeded leader to `out` and THEN checks `if len(out) >= limit: break`. When real leaders count < limit < 5, the first pad iteration always appends before breaking, causing the response to exceed `limit` by 1. Fix: move the break check to before the append, or use `if len(out) >= limit: break` at the top of the loop body.
